import{useEffect,useState}from"react";import{supabase}from"../lib/supabase";export default function useScrapPrices(){const[prices,setPrices]=useState([]);useEffect(()=>{async function fetchPrices(){const{data,error}=await supabase.from("scrap_prices").select("*").order("display_order",{ascending:true});if(!error)setPrices(data);}fetchPrices();const channel=supabase.channel("scrap-prices").on("postgres_changes",{event:"*",schema:"public",table:"scrap_prices"},()=>{fetchPrices();// refresh data when anything changes
}).subscribe();return()=>{supabase.removeChannel(channel);};},[]);return prices;}
